name: figma_set_variables_mode
description: Switch the active Figma Variables mode (e.g. Dark Mode, Light Mode, Brand theme) for a specific artboard/frame or the entire page.

target_id.description: Target node ID (frame/artboard) to set mode on. If omitted, applies to current selection or active page.

capture.description: Whether to capture a PNG screenshot of the target after switching mode (default: true)

target.description: fileName of a specific connected Figma document, when more than one is open (see figma_list_targets).
